_photo_role: genuine photo 38 min after drop-off, standard-tier amount, no receipt, rider argues back

dispute_ticket.description: I only ran at the park and my shoes were barely wet. S$60 for this is unfair, and the driver has no receipt. Please cancel it.

chat_logs.content: At the carpark entrance, silver Noah.
Sir, your shoes left a lot of wet mud on my mat and seat edge. The carpet is stained and I will photograph it here. Claim submitted at the lowest tier.
It rained, that is not my fault. It is just a little mud.

app_events.details: Rider R-6153 booked trip RYDE-PS-010 from MacRitchie Reservoir Park to Blk 301 Clementi Ave 4.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$60.00 with 1 photo.
No cleaning receipt attached; amount within the S$120 stain tier.
S$60.00 cleaning fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip. The fee is paid to the driver.

cleaning_fee_tiers.value: food or drink spill up to S$40; stains (mud, dirt) and bodily fluids up to S$120; vomit up to S$200
cleaning_fee_tiers.text: Usual fee by type of mess; a fee above the tier for the mess type needs a receipt.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.value: photo of the mess and a cleaning receipt where available
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

photo_window_after_dropoff_min.text: A cleaning claim needs at least one photo of the mess taken within 60 minutes after drop-off, at or near the drop-off point.

photo_doubt_rule.text: If a photo's authenticity, timing, place or content is in doubt, a case officer decides; the fee is neither confirmed nor removed automatically.

rider_may_dispute_if.text: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.

evidence.description: Mud on the floor mat, taken at the Clementi drop-off point.

expected_outcome.reason: The photo was taken at 11:36, 38 min after the 10:58 drop-off (inside the 60-minute window) at GPS about 170 m from the drop-off at Clementi Ave 4, and shows mud on the floor mat. The driver raised it in chat at 11:03, and the rider's reply ('just a little mud') concedes there was mud. No receipt is attached, but S$60 is a standard amount within the S$120 stain tier and the S$200 cap, and the policy asks for a receipt only where available. The rider's ground (rain) is not a ground the policy accepts. The fee stands; refund S$0.
